name: @gears-frontx/template-design-guardrails
description: Adds a governed interface-generation and design-review contract to an existing FrontX project. The template contributes no runtime screen and owns no application code; it installs a short human-readable entry point, the @gears-frontx/design-verify workspace package (the runtime design-defect checker, the composed-markup axe suite, and the jsx-a11y lint fragment, with their dependencies), plus an AI-extension bundle with procedural skills, detailed design standards, component-state requirements, quality gates, and advisory review workflows.
